log.notes_to_self: Day 1: selected national plus forum and foreign victims only; all deaths afternoon. Keep quick deaths in afternoon to preserve night workers, students and at-home routines (55% population). Avoid adding a third non-national reporting category before feedback: three accessible 25% categories could reduce pool below 1,000. Forum+foreign both traced and accessible would leave about 3,438 suspects; either inaccessible yields a larger pool. National reports are safe. Two of regional/sector/age/forum/foreign are inaccessible to L, but which two is unknown. First feedback after day 3; use it to infer whether forum/foreign constraints have registered.

Day 2: killed national d2-5, foreign d2-2/d2-8, forum d2-4/d2-9, all quick afternoon. Total 10 kills over days 1–2. Continue afternoon-only deaths to retain night workers, students, and at-home routines (55%). Restrict non-national victims to forum/foreign pending feedback after day 3. If both categories traceable, pool floor from these constraints is about 3,438; adding another traceable category could cause capture. Two of regional/sector/age/forum/foreign are inaccessible to L, identities unknown. National victims are safe. Reported_in lists only our observed outlets; additional hidden reporting may render traces ineffective or weaken constraints. First press feedback will help infer constraints, but rounding and limited traces prevent certainty.

Day 3: killed national d3-10, foreign d3-2/d3-8, forum d3-5/d3-9, all quick afternoon. Total 15 kills over days 1–3. Keep all deaths afternoon: compatible routines total 55% (night workers, students, at-home). Restrict non-national kills to forum and foreign for now; even if both are traceable and separately established, pool floor is 100000*0.55*0.25*0.25=3437.5, safely above 1000. Adding a traceable region, sector, or age constraint could cause capture. Two of regional/sector/age/forum/foreign are inaccessible, unknown which. Hidden reporting may block traces or weaken constraints. Check first press conference after day 3; rounded pool and only three traces/day mean absence of narrowing does not prove a category inaccessible. National victims are safe. Need higher volume eventually for 30/40 deaths per rolling five days, but avoid new exposure before evaluating feedback.
